span.p:
背压检查(修后):
只数『传输一直失败、
还在重试』的批

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
暂不开新批
先把失败批重试成功

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
攒批:30 秒窗口
最多 10 条打包

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
写进 Lead 屏幕
(传输成功)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
只记『已通知』时间
notified_at —— 不算送达

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Lead 读到并签收?
(ack = 整批签收)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
✅ 此刻才盖『已送达』章
delivered_at = 签收时刻

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
先判活:
收件 Lead 还活着吗?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
重新投递
(最多 3 轮,之后死信上报)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
先挂起不投
等它被系统拉回来再投

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
批转死信 + 告警
发给还活着的负责人
